THE OBVIOUS FIX IS WRONG AND WAS TRIED FIRST -- do not re-derive it. Running 'odoo-bin i18n export' over these six and committing the result reaches the identical 359 and DELETES 1,988 msgids from base.pot and 155 from account.pot, because an export reflects the database it runs against and mine had 60 modules installed where the committed catalogues came from a far fuller one.
